bias.en: Rebound · reclaimed the September lows, under every average
bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 9 月低点，仍在所有均线下方

read.en: Tesla rose 4.2% on Nov 6 to $358.22, trading $347.60–363.84. It remains below every average: the falling 5-day ($377.9), 100-day ($366.8) and 200-day ($383.9) and the rising 10-day ($389.6) and 30-day ($376.4). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, still above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 ($410.44), and RSI is 42.
read.zh: 特斯拉 11月6日上涨 4.2%，收于 $358.22，盘中区间 $347.60–363.84。股价仍位于所有均线下方：下行的 5 日（$377.9）、100 日（$366.8）和 200 日均线（$383.9），以及上行的 10 日（$389.6）和 30 日均线（$376.4）。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴上方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（$410.44），RSI 为 42。

read.en: The bounce reclaimed the $345.9–349.3 September–October lows, support again; the Nov 6 low ($347.60) held inside that zone. Resistance is $366.8–368.1 (100-day, Oct 19 close), then $376.4–377.9 (30 and 5-day) and $383.9–388 (200-day, $388 cap). Support is $345.9–349.3, then $337.2–338.2 (Apr 7 and Nov 5 lows) and $325.2–331.1. A close above $368.1 would target $376–378; below $345.9, $337–338.

s.en: Sep 30 low $345.88; Oct 16 low $349.33, reclaimed; Nov 6 low $347.60
